about: Per-tool risk table for hooks/craft-mcp-guard.py. The guard only ever ASKS. Names are matched after lowercasing and dropping every non-alphanumeric character, so 'doc_print', 'doc.print' and 'docPrint' are the same name; a leading 'cmd_' is dropped from LightCraft tool names. 'runners' are tools that run another command by id (command_run, execute, batch ...): the ids found in their arguments are checked against 'ask' and 'save' as well. Tool names and parameters were read from the live servers (see 'captured'); command ids are the ones LightCraft documents in its cmd_* tool descriptions. 'ask_ids' are command ids only (run through a runner, or typed as script text); they are not tool names, so the snapshots in data/tools cannot confirm them: they are the ids the app's skill names in its Never list (read from the live list_commands when the skills were written), and each must appear in that skill. 'command_text' (CADCraft) lists the words typed into command_line or script that ask. Anything not listed here is not checked, apart from the global rules and the workspace path check.
